issues.title: Ingest Jackson County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $13,694,394 across 36 funds. The largest: General Fund ($4,943,381), Road Fund ($2,889,749), Jail Sales & Use Tax Operating Fund ($1,304,932). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Road Fund
issues.detail: Printed total is $2,889,749.00; the parts listed add to $2,899,749.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
